text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Metallic Stoneware Vase, 11.8"H, Gold
Materials: Stoneware
Accent your home or office with this striking metallic-gold vase. Perfect on its own as an elegant centerpiece or as a container for flowers, this vase will perfectly complete your mid-century-modern home decor. 5.12" diameter x 11.8"H 100% stoneware This stoneware vase with metallic-gold finish can also hold water for fresh-cut flowers. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
